text:
sophie_partners: Heads up: AuroraEdge + Snowflake + Databricks asked for a joint marketplace launch + on-prem demo. Need a fast preflight, owners, and a public fallback.

liam_eng: I can take infra for the on-prem demo. Need image checksum and a non-prod serial list for telemetry sims.

carlos_infra: Will carve a sandbox VPC and enable masked telemetry. Please send the appliance image SHA256.

sam_si: SI checklist: SAML, KMS mapping, Databricks notebook, and a Qdrant index load. Who will own the notebook?

sophie_partners: @sam_si own the notebook. @nora_marketing will draft co-sell copy and screenshots.

nora_marketing: Drafting tile copy now. Legal: will logos be allowed?

legal: Logos require partner LOI and brand guidelines. Send assets to legal@redwood.company. No partner quotes without written approval.

liam_eng: Fallback plan: if appliance fails, run the same demo on Redwood Dedicated with containerized AuroraEdge runtime — keeps announcement schedule.

carlos_infra: Quick infra snippet I'll add to repo for allowlist:
```bash
# temp allowlist for AuroraEdge CI
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-demo --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 198.51.100.0/28
```

sophie_partners: Timeline: T-7 SHA + CI IPs, T-5 infra ready, T-3 SI dry-run, T-1 legal + screenshots. Everyone OK?

sam_si: OK. I'll schedule the SI dry-run and post the notebook link here.

nora_marketing: I'll share screenshots T-2 and the marketplace copy T-4.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: sandpit/demo-cluster deploy 2026-04-08 01:00 UTC (rolling).

sophie_partners: Action items recap: @liam_eng image validation, @carlos_infra VPC + mask telemetry, @sam_si SI run, @nora_marketing assets, @legal approvals. Post blockers ASAP. :white_check_mark:
